mapper.insert: insert into booking_coupon_tcc_operation (order_id, coupon_id, status) values (#{orderId}, #{couponId}, #{status})
mapper.select: select order_id, coupon_id, status, created_at, updated_at from booking_coupon_tcc_operation where status in ('TRYING', 'CONFIRMING', 'CANCELING') order by updated_at
